LAST MINUTE CRUISES Overview
Image

Book Last Minute Cruises Now and Save Big!

Last minute cruise deals make it possible to sail away on a spontaneous getaway. From tropical paradises to historic landmarks, there are plenty of last minute discount cruises to choose from. Whether you're able to leave on a moment's or a week's notice, you can get huge savings on your cruise vacations with CruiseDirect!

Sailing away to fabulous destination ports and foreign countries is adventurous and loads of fun. When someone asks if you have plans for the weekend, wouldn't it be great to tell them you scored a last minute cruise deal and are embarking on a quick vacation to the Caribbean or Europe?

Sometimes, you'll also be able to score last minute cruise deals because of cancellations; you might find yourself in a prime stateroom on a fantastic ship for a discounted price. Last minute cruise options for different cruise lines, ships, dates, and itineraries fluctuate greatly, so if you can't find something that excites you right away, check back often. CruiseDirect always offers the best cruise deals with last minute discounted prices backed by our lowest price guarantee!

What to Know Before Taking a Last Minute Cruise Vacation

Can I Find Last Minute Cruises and Deals From Florida?

Absolutely! Last minute deals on cruises sailing from Florida are quite common, with ports like Miami, Fort Lauderdale, and Port Canaveral offering a variety of itineraries.

Can I Find Luxury Cruises at the Last Minute for Cheap?

Yes, last minute luxury cruises, such as those offered by Regent Seven Seas, Viking, and Oceania, are also available, offering the same benefits and high-end amenities that you'd expect from a luxury cruise at reduced prices. Availability of luxury last minute cruises might be more limited compared to mainstream cruises, but if you can score a deal on a dream cruise, book it!

Are There Any Extra Fees for Booking a Cruise Last Minute?

While the cruise fare might be lower when you take advantage of a last minute cruise deal, additional costs could include last minute airfare, expedited passport services, and onboard expenses. Always review the total cost before booking.

Can I Book a Cruise Two Days Before it Leaves?

Yes, you can book a last minute cruise last minute as little as two days before departure. If for any reason you're unable to book a last minute cruise until days before your desired travel date, our specialists can help you find the best available options on short notice. Our team is dedicated to running a last minute cruise deals website that offers travelers the lowest prices online on last minute cruise bookings to a variety of popular destinations.

How Many Days Before a Cruise Can I Cancel?

Cancellation policies vary by cruise line. Typically, the closer you are to the departure date, the more cancellation fees tend to increase. For those booking last minute cruise deals, be sure to check the specific cancellation policies for the cruise line and plan the different aspects of your cruise vacation accordingly.

Is it Better to Book a Cruise Sooner or Later?

Booking a cruise sooner ensures that you get your preferred cabin and itinerary, but for those who are able to be a little more flexible with their cruise vacation details, last minute cruise deals might be the best way to cruise for less. Waiting until closer to the departure date can sometimes yield significant savings.
